svg.title: vi, showcase and gate
svg.desc: vi owns the research, the constructions and the where and count semantics. showcase is a separate repository with the worked company, its rendering and its policy, and it pins a revision of vi. gate brings records from other projects to a judge built from a pinned revision of vi. A versioned contract with conformance fixtures states what an implementation of a check must pass.

g.aria-label: Each check has one owner of its meaning.
g.data-vi-text: Each check has one owner of its meaning.

g.aria-label: Bring a question, a record and access to work.
g.data-vi-text: Bring a question, a record and access to work.

g.aria-label: Question / semantics · accepted input · response form · conformance suite
g.data-vi-text: Question / semantics · accepted input · response form · conformance suite

g.aria-label: Each check has its own version. Passing the finite fixtures shows conformance on that suite.
g.data-vi-text: Each check has its own version. Passing the finite fixtures shows conformance on that suite.

g.aria-label: NOW vi and showcase are separate repositories, and showcase pins vi. Gate pins an older revision.
g.data-vi-text: NOW vi and showcase are separate repositories, and showcase pins vi. Gate pins an older revision.

g.aria-label: A Rust sample of the judge passes the finite suite of the contract. NEXT Gate re-pins through the contract.
g.data-vi-text: A Rust sample of the judge passes the finite suite of the contract. NEXT Gate re-pins through the contract.
